candidates.name: agent-context-trimmer (LLM Agent Context & Token Cost Auditor)
candidates.summary: Zero-dependency Node CLI tool that scans AI coding agent configs (.cursorrules, .gemini/rules, CLINEmode, system prompts), identifies redundant instructions, measures token burn, and generates an actionable optimization report showing monthly cost savings.
pros: Addresses massive current pain point in AI developer community
Zero external API dependencies, €0 build cost, runs 100% offline
Demonstrable instant ROI: saving 5,000 tokens/turn saves €5 in hours of coding
Can be packaged as a single zero-dependency file or portable zip
cons: Token counting algorithms vary slightly across models (approximation needed)
Free simple alternatives exist, but lack automated rule consolidation and visual report

candidates.name: artifact-customs (Cryptographic Delivery & SHA-256 Manifest Verifier)
candidates.summary: Standalone CLI tool extracted from Courier ResultCustoms that verifies physical build outputs against a cryptographic manifest, detecting silent truncation, missing files, and corrupted binaries.
pros: Code already 100% proven in Courier governance plane
cons: Many developers write quick 5-line bash/python scripts instead of paying €5
Less urgent emotional buying impulse than runaway token costs

candidates.name: godot4-deterministic-state-machine (Game Dev Component)
candidates.summary: Clean, production-ready Hierarchical Finite State Machine (HFSM) GDScript template for Godot 4 with visual debug overlay, transition events, and unit tests.
pros: Active commercial ecosystem on Itch.io and Godot Asset Library ($3-$5 standard pricing)
Highly valued by indie game developers
cons: No Godot engine binary currently installed in local Windows environment to run automated tests
Requires headless Godot engine for verified testing

candidates.name: dev-short-script-generator (Technical Video Script & Asset Planner)
candidates.summary: CLI + template engine that parses repository features and generates structured 4-phase 30-60s video demo scripts with spoken text, visual cues, and on-screen overlays.
pros: High perceived value for indie hackers wanting marketing scripts
cons: Still leaves the user with the work of recording/voicing the video

candidates.name: ntfs-file-mutex (Cross-Platform Case-Safe Lock & Run)
candidates.summary: CLI wrapper that executes long-running commands under an exclusive case-safe file mutex on Windows and POSIX systems.
pros: Solves obscure concurrency race conditions on Windows
cons: Niche developer pain point; difficult to market as a standalone commercial product

candidates.name: supabase-to-postgres-migration-kit (Self-Hosting Blueprint)
candidates.summary: Complete SQL schema extractor, auth mock, and Docker-compose self-hosting template to migrate workloads off Supabase.
pros: High willingness to pay when a company is facing big cloud bills
cons: High support burden: every customer has custom extensions/functions
Takes significantly longer to build and verify reliably

candidates.name: freelance-delivery-escrow-ledger (Milestone Proof Package)
candidates.summary: Cryptographic milestone delivery ledger generating client-verifiable delivery certificates and SHA-256 asset manifests.
cons: Requires both freelancer and client to participate in verification flow
